cytraprinter.config.comment.printing: Turns the printer on or off. Bind a key to toggle it in the Hotkeys tab.
cytraprinter.config.comment.placementsPe:
Most blocks placed per game tick (20 ticks per second).
Vanilla servers have no limit; lower this if a server kicks you.
cytraprinter.config.comment.tickDelay: Ticks to wait between printer rounds. 0 = every tick (fastest).
cytraprinter.config.comment.extraReach:
Blocks of reach on top of your normal reach. The server allows up to 1.0;
0.8 leaves a margin for lag.
cytraprinter.config.comment.useServerHel:
When the server also runs Alloy Printer, let it set the exact rotation
of every block. Blocks vanilla can't rotate by clicking then still print.
cytraprinter.config.comment.hotbarSlots:
Hotbar slots (1-9) the printer may put blocks and tools into,
when they aren't already in your hotbar. Example: 7,8,9
cytraprinter.config.comment.restockFromC:
When a block runs out, ask Alloy Container to pull it from shulker boxes
or linked storage (its 'printer pulls' setting must be on).
cytraprinter.config.comment.fixWrongBloc:
Break blocks that are the wrong block or face the wrong way, then place the right one.
Creative: instant. Survival: mined with the best tool in your inventory.
cytraprinter.config.comment.clearExtraBl:
Also break blocks inside the schematic area where the schematic has air
(terrain, leftovers). Off by default.
cytraprinter.config.comment.breakContain:
Allow breaking wrong chests, barrels, shulker boxes etc.
Off: they are only reported, so nothing spills.
cytraprinter.config.comment.clickFixStat:
Right-click placed blocks until their setting matches: repeater delay, comparator mode,
note block pitch, daylight sensor mode, wooden doors, trapdoors and fence gates open/closed.
cytraprinter.config.comment.clickFixLeve: Also flip levers to match. They are flipped last, after everything else in reach is done.
cytraprinter.config.comment.signText: Write the schematic's front text onto signs the printer places.
cytraprinter.config.comment.safeRedstone:
Observers, pistons, dispensers and droppers wait until the blocks around them are done,
so they don't fire or push mid-build. Observers always wait for the block they watch.
cytraprinter.config.comment.maxRetries: How often one spot is retried before the printer leaves it alone for 30 seconds.
cytraprinter.config.comment.showHud: Show the printer status box while printing.
cytraprinter.config.comment.hudX: Distance of the status box from the left edge (GUI pixels).
cytraprinter.config.comment.hudY: Distance of the status box from the top edge (GUI pixels).
cytraprinter.gui.title: Alloy Printer
cytraprinter.config.comment.pauseOnLag:
Stop printing while the server is lagging (no time update for 2 seconds),
so clicks don't pile up and land wrong.
cytraprinter.config.comment.disableOnDea: Switch printing off when you die, so it doesn't start building at your spawn.
cytraprinter.config.comment.safeObserver:
Extra checks so observers don't fire mid-build: a line of observers waits until
every block down the line is done, an observer next to a wall/fence/wire (which changes
shape when the observer appears) waits while something behind it would react,
and pistons/dispensers wait for placed observers aimed at them.
cytraprinter.config.comment.excludedBloc:
Blocks the printer never places or fixes. Block ids or tags, e.g. stone, minecraft:tnt, #wool.
Bind "Exclude Looked-At Block" in Hotkeys to add or remove the block you look at.
cytraprinter.config.comment.protectedBlo: Blocks the printer never breaks, even when wrong or extra. Block ids or tags.
cytraprinter.config.comment.stripLogs:
When you have no stripped logs/wood/stems but do have the plain ones and an axe,
place the plain one and strip it. Plain logs already in place are stripped instead of broken.
cytraprinter.config.comment.composterLev:
Fill composters to their fill level in the schematic with compostable items
(best chance first; never items the build still needs). A full composter is emptied first.
cytraprinter.config.comment.composterIte:
Items the printer may put into composters. Empty = any compostable item.
Item ids or tags, e.g. wheat_seeds, kelp, #saplings.
cytraprinter.config.comment.liveCoralFor:
With no dead coral in your inventory, place live coral where the schematic has dead coral
and there's no water; it dies into the dead one by itself after a few seconds.
cytraprinter.config.comment.coralWaitFor:
Only place live coral once there is water in or next to its spot, so it doesn't die.
Dead coral where live coral belongs is left until water is there.
cytraprinter.config.comment.breakBedrock:
Survival: remove listed blocks (bedrock) where the schematic wants something else, with
the piston trick. Needs pistons, redstone torches, slime blocks (if there's no floor) and a
pickaxe that mines pistons instantly (Efficiency V + Haste II). Where the schematic has air
this also needs Clear Extra Blocks. Creative: just breaks them.
cytraprinter.config.comment.bedrockBlock: Blocks that Break Bedrock removes. Default: bedrock. Block ids or tags.
cytraprinter.config.comment.excludeLooke: Adds the block you look at (schematic or real) to Excluded Blocks, or removes it.
cytraprinter.hud.bedrock.materials: Bedrock: need pistons and redstone torches
cytraprinter.hud.bedrock.pickaxe: Bedrock: need a pickaxe that mines pistons instantly (Efficiency V + Haste II)
cytraprinter.hud.bedrock.room: Bedrock: no room above it for the piston and torch
cytraprinter.status.helper.missing: Not on this server (vanilla mode, still exact)
cytraprinter.msg.exclude_none: Look at a block to exclude it
cytraprinter.hub.needs_litematica: Alloy Printer needs Litematica and MaLiLib on the client. Only the server helper part is active.
cytraprinter.hub.server.helper.hint: Lets printers on this server place every block with the exact rotation. Off = clients fall back to vanilla mode.
cytraprinter.config.comment.showSkipped:
Outline, through walls, the spots the printer left alone: red = wrong block it won't fix, orange = can't place it exactly from where you stood, yellow = gave up for now.
They stay outlined after you walk away until they're right, or until Retry.
cytraprinter.config.comment.skippedRange: How far away (blocks) skipped spots are still outlined.
cytraprinter.config.comment.nextSkipped: Points you to the nearest skipped spot (the next one on each press) and makes its outline pulse. Turns your view to it when printing is off.
cytraprinter.config.comment.retrySkipped: Forgets parked and failed spots so the printer tries them again right away, and clears the outlines.
cytraprinter.hub.retried: The printer tries the skipped spots again
cytraprinter.config.comment.tillFarmland: Make farmland with a hoe: dirt, grass and paths are tilled (coarse and rooted dirt in two clicks), and an empty spot gets dirt first. Crops, stems and nether wart are then planted on top as usual.
cytraprinter.config.comment.railShapes: With Rail Placement Fix installed (on your client and on the server), rails are placed sneaking in exactly the schematic's shape (curves, slopes) without bending neighbouring rails. Without that mod this does nothing.
